name: 管理者ロールで使える機能の一覧
prompt:
Recreate only the Basecamp Administrators crop, matching the original 1120x567 composition. Use the source crop as a measured layout reference. The left edge is intentional: start the Administrators heading, avatar circle, admin-introduction heading, and all eight feature icons at x=0 with no added left padding. Keep the top of the Administrators heading at y=0. In the source, feature labels begin about 48 px to the right of their 38 px icon circles, with roughly 46 px vertical row spacing. Keep the original generous vertical gaps between the avatar row, introduction, and feature list. Do not center or inset the content column. Do not include the Account Owners section below or surrounding page navigation. No Japanese mock exists.

At the top, show 「管理者」 in bold dark gray with a thin light-gray divider beginning about x=220 and extending right. Below it, use a gray circular avatar with white initials “AS” and the name “Alex Smith”. Farther down, add bold 「管理者として、次の操作ができます…」.

Show exactly eight evenly spaced feature rows in order, each with a 38 px pale-blue circular background, centered blue icon, and dark-gray Japanese label beginning about 48 px from the left: 「ユーザーを管理」 (people), 「管理者を追加/削除」 (briefcase), 「グループを管理」 (group), 「会社を管理」 (building), 「プロジェクトツール名を変更」 (project tools), 「メッセージカテゴリを変更」 (list/category), 「ボイスメモをオン/オフ」 (microphone), 「ユーザーを統合」 (merge arrows). Keep the circles separated by white gaps as in the source. Preserve the flat white surface, colors, typography size and alignment. Keep Alex Smith and AS in Latin letters. Do not add a card, new borders, or controls.
reviewNotes: LH09-0259 v002 compared side by side with the exact Basecamp source crop. It preserves the aspect ratio, name and initials, introduction, and all eight translated rows in order; the major left inset is smaller than v001. Remaining material defects: content still starts about 24 px inside the source left edge, row spacing is slightly compressed, and the project-tools row uses a folder icon where the source shows a distinct rename-tools symbol. Status: needs-correction after two attempts; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
